Enter the world of the warrior Clans—four groups of wild cats bound by a shared code, ancient rivalries, and deep loyalty.


This pack brings together the first three audiobooks in Erin Hunter’s bestselling Warriors series, where epic battles, forest politics, and hidden secrets set the stage for a gripping fantasy adventure. As he earns his place among the ThunderClan and becomes Fireheart, he discovers that survival means more than strength—it means navigating shifting alliances, uncovering dangerous truths, and standing firm even when loyalty is tested.
